parts.reference:
1.   Which of the following processes absorb free energy (i.e., are endergonic)?
          i. Nitrogen fixation
          ii. Respiration
          iii. Photosynthesis
          iv. Maintenance of homeostasis
     a.   i only
     b.   i and ii
     c.   i, iii, and iv
     d.   ii and iv
     e.   iii and iv
